name: Dialogue Health Technologies Inc.
summary: Dialogue Health Technologies Inc. operates a digital healthcare and wellness platform in Canada. Its Integrated Health Platform is a healthcare hub that provides access to virtual healthcare, stress management, mental wellbeing, and other orientation and counselling services. The company's platform also enables its members and their dependents to access an employee assistance program and an occupational health and safety program for customers in Germany. It serves employers and organizations. Dialogue Technologies Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Montreal, Canada.
